priorConsolidatedEvidence.problem: The prior consolidated status could be derived from stored readiness evidence without forcing a live DB readiness refresh.

priorSmokeEvidence.problem: The smoke caught a live preflight contradiction where readiness returned unknown/zero DB state.

confirmedFindings.finding: Stale readiness evidence could previously carry a ready claim.
confirmedFindings.resolution: The consolidated Forge dev status CLI now refreshes live Benton DB readiness by default before reading readiness-dependent status.

confirmedFindings.finding: Live DB evidence collection can exceed a short status refresh timeout.
confirmedFindings.resolution: The status gate refresh timeout is 240000 ms so the docker DB evidence path can complete instead of leaving stale or unknown readiness in place.

confirmedFindings.finding: The unknown/zero DB readiness record was not confirmed empty DB state.
confirmedFindings.resolution: Direct read-only DB evidence later returned nonzero Benton counts and the readiness gate returned REAL_DEV_DATA_AVAILABLE.

confirmedFindings.finding: The latest smoke reached Vite but did not complete a clean full dev launch.
confirmedFindings.resolution: The smoke is recorded as blocked by occupied local ports 4317 and 5046, not by DB readiness.

rootCause.primary: Consolidated Forge dev status did not require live readiness refresh before reporting forgeDevAllowed=true.
rootCause.secondary: The runtime DB evidence path is slower than the original short refresh window, creating false blocked/unknown evidence when the collection path was interrupted or stale.
rootCause.currentRuntimeBlocker: Local port conflicts on 127.0.0.1:4317 and http://127.0.0.1:5046 prevent a clean full dev smoke launch.

enforcedRule: No live DB readiness, no Forge dev ready claim.
